title: Keyturn Trip Booking Return Condition Tariff: Fuel, Charge and Cleanliness Figures
content:
The figures a Keyturn Trip Booking carries for the state the vehicle comes back in are plan figures: the percentage points of tank or battery the vehicle may be returned short by without charge, the flat service fee and the per-point rate for refuelling a combustion vehicle, the flat service fee and the per-point rate for recharging an electric vehicle, and the fees for a vehicle needing more than ordinary cleaning, for evidence of smoking and for pet hair requiring specialist cleaning.

| Figure | Hourly | Daily | Weekend | Weekly | Monthly | Extended Stay |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Return tolerance (percentage points of tank or battery) | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 |
| Refuelling service fee (USD) | 22.00 | 28.00 | 30.00 | 34.00 | 38.00 | 42.00 |
| Refuelling rate for each percentage point (USD) | 1.15 | 1.35 | 1.40 | 1.45 | 1.50 | 1.55 |
| Recharging service fee (USD) | 18.00 | 22.00 | 24.00 | 28.00 | 32.00 | 36.00 |
| Recharging rate for each percentage point (USD) | 0.85 | 0.95 | 1.00 | 1.05 | 1.10 | 1.15 |
| Cleaning fee (USD) | 45.00 | 75.00 | 85.00 | 95.00 | 125.00 | 165.00 |
| Smoking violation fee (USD) | 250.00 | 350.00 | 350.00 | 400.00 | 450.00 | 500.00 |
| Pet hair fee (USD) | 110.00 | 150.00 | 150.00 | 175.00 | 200.00 | 225.00 |

### Reading across the ladder

The return tolerance is the one figure in this tariff that does not move: it is 5 percentage points of tank or battery on every one of the six rate plans.

The refuelling and recharging figures run in pairs, and on every plan the recharging service fee and per-point rate sit below the refuelling ones — 18.00 against 22.00 USD and 0.85 against 1.15 USD on the Keyturn Hourly Rate Plan, 36.00 against 42.00 USD and 1.15 against 1.55 USD on the Keyturn Extended Stay Rate Plan. The three condition fees rise with the plan, the smoking violation fee standing level at 350.00 USD across the Keyturn Daily and Weekend Rate Plans and the pet hair fee level at 150.00 USD across the same two.
